chunks: ALL PRAISE BE to God who has revealed to His votary the Book which is free of all obliquity,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Quran is free of obliquity?
ai.summary: This verse, the opening of Surah Al-Kahf, establishes the Quran's absolute integrity (khalas) and lack of distortion (awj), a key tenet in Shia exegesis affirming the preservation of the divine text. It serves as a foundational declaration of the Prophet's role as the recipient of this flawless guidance, reinforcing the concept of Ismah (infallibility) regarding the transmission of revelation.
